 Puka Nacua (MCL) could miss remainder of season 
 by Chris Schommer | Rams Correspondent | Fri, Nov 20th 2026, 12:07pm EST 
 Puka Nacua will undergo MCL surgery and could potentially miss the remainder of the season for the Los Angeles Rams according to Adam Schefter. ( Adam Schefter on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Rams standout WR Puka Nacua is undergo surgery on his MCL surgery and now could miss the rest of the season.
Rams HC Sean McVay confirmed the surgery while saying Nacua will be out “a couple of months.”
— Adam Schefter (@AdamSchefter) November 20, 2026
